reason: Notarize is the notarization product on the Proof platform. Proof recommends api.proof.com for new integrations while retaining api.notarize.com indefinitely with the same credentials.

evidence.supports: Proof documents the Notarize-to-Proof rebrand, application redirects, the recommended api.proof.com endpoint, and shared credentials across both API hostnames.
Proof identifies itself as the platform created by Notarize and documents one Business and Real Estate API surface for identity verification, eSign, and notarization.
Proof presents Notarize as its remote-online-notarization product rather than a separate integration platform.
